meaning.en: Good at sensing what others feel and need; considerate and understanding.
meaning.zh: 能够理解别人的心思，体贴人。

examples.zh: 她善解人意，总能在你需要时递上一杯热茶。
examples.en: She is so perceptive that she always hands you a hot cup of tea just when you need it.

examples.zh: 善解人意的客服赢得了顾客的好评。
examples.en: The considerate customer-service agent won praise from customers.

usage.en: Praise for a person's character, often of women or caregivers; used as an attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 褒义，形容人性格体贴，可作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: To produce only a very small effect.
meaning.zh: 取得的效果很小。

examples.zh: 这些措施收效甚微，问题依然严重。
examples.en: These measures have had little effect and the problem remains serious.

examples.zh: 补习了半年，成绩却收效甚微。
examples.en: After half a year of extra lessons, the results were scarcely better.

usage.en: A formal phrase common in news and essays; negative or at best disappointed. Do not write 效果甚微 for this fixed phrase.
usage.zh: 书面语，新闻、议论文常用，多表示失望。

meaning.en: The naive, idealistic and impractical attitude of a scholar who knows little of real life.
meaning.zh: 读书人不通世故、爱凭理想行事的脾气和作风。

examples.zh: 他书生意气，不懂得官场的潜规则。
examples.en: With his bookish idealism he doesn't understand unwritten rules in officialdom.

examples.zh: 当年我们书生意气，挥斥方遒。
examples.en: In those days we were full of youthful, scholarly spirit.

usage.en: Can be mildly critical (naive) or warmly nostalgic (youthful idealism); depends on context. 挥斥方遒 is a related quote.
usage.zh: 可贬可褒：批评不谙世故，或怀念青年理想。

meaning.en: Extremely painful emotionally, or with piercing loudness (of crying and coughing).
meaning.zh: 形容极度悲痛，或哭喊、咳嗽的声音极其剧烈。

examples.zh: 她撕心裂肺地哭喊着孩子的名字。
examples.en: She cried out her child's name in a heart-rending wail.

examples.zh: 失去亲人的痛苦撕心裂肺。
examples.en: The pain of losing a loved one is wrenching.

usage.en: Usually an adverbial: 撕心裂肺地…. It can also describe violent coughing, a painful physical or emotional scene.
usage.zh: 多作状语，“撕心裂肺地哭/咳”。

meaning.en: A woman going without make-up.
meaning.zh: 不施脂粉，不加打扮，女子不化妆。

examples.zh: 她素面朝天，却依旧清丽动人。
examples.en: She wore no make-up and was still fresh and lovely.

examples.zh: 不少明星素面朝天出镜，赢得了好评。
examples.en: Many stars have appeared bare-faced and won praise.

story.en: The Tang beauty Lady Guoguo, sister of Yang Guifei, was so confident of her looks that she went before the emperor wearing no powder.
story.zh: “虢国不施脂粉，自炫美艳，常素面朝天。”

usage.en: Neutral or admiring; mostly of women. 朝 is read cháo ('face towards'), not zhāo.
usage.zh: 中性或褒义，多指女子。“朝”读 cháo，不读 zhāo。

meaning.en: Hard work will be rewarded; success favours the diligent.
meaning.zh: 上天会酬报勤奋的人，勤奋努力终有回报。

examples.zh: 天道酬勤，他苦练三年终于考上了心仪的大学。
examples.en: Hard work pays off: after three years of grind he got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 相信天道酬勤，只要努力就会有收获。
examples.en: I believe diligence is rewarded; effort brings results.

usage.en: A motivational saying, popular on school banners and in exams; no classical origin for the exact phrase is firmly attested. 酬 chóu = reward.
usage.zh: 励志用语，常见于标语、作文。“酬”读 chóu，意为回报。

meaning.en: To work or study late into the night under lamplight.
meaning.zh: 夜里点灯奋战，指熬夜工作、学习。

examples.zh: 期末考试前，同学们挑灯夜战。
examples.en: Before the finals, students burned the midnight oil.

examples.zh: 为了赶项目，团队连续一周挑灯夜战。
examples.en: To meet the project deadline, the team worked late nights for a week.

usage.en: 挑 is read tiǎo here (to trim the wick, raise the lamp), not tiāo. Neutral to positive.
usage.zh: “挑”读 tiǎo，意为拨亮灯芯。多含褒义。

natural: go among the people in disguise

meaning.en: (Of an official or ruler) to go among ordinary people in plain clothes to learn the truth.
meaning.zh: 旧指官员或帝王隐藏身份，穿便服暗中察访民情。

examples.zh: 皇帝微服私访，了解百姓疾苦。
examples.en: The emperor went in disguise to learn of the people's hardships.

examples.zh: 新来的县长微服私访，查看了集市和学校。
examples.en: The new magistrate toured the market and school incognito.

usage.en: Historical flavour; now used for officials, bosses or celebrities who visit unannounced. 服 here means clothes.
usage.zh: 带历史色彩，现也用于领导、老板暗访。“服”指衣服。

meaning.en: A statement that goes against one's true feelings or beliefs.
meaning.zh: 不符合自己真实想法的言论。

examples.zh: 为了讨好领导，他说了不少违心之论。
examples.en: To please the boss he said a lot he didn't believe.

examples.zh: 我不想发表违心之论，只讲实话。
examples.en: I don't want to say what I don't mean; I'll tell the truth.

usage.en: Negative; often paired with 说. 违 means 'go against'; do not confuse with 言不由衷 (a related idiom, adjectival).
usage.zh: 贬义，常与“说、发表”搭配。

meaning.en: To chase from behind and block the way ahead, trapping the target.
meaning.zh: 前后夹击，包围追赶，拦截去路。

examples.zh: 红军突破了敌军的围追堵截。
examples.en: The Red Army broke through the enemy's encirclement and pursuit.

examples.zh: 记者对明星围追堵截，令他无处可躲。
examples.en: Reporters hounded and cornered the star so he had nowhere to hide.

usage.en: Mostly about military pursuit, now also about the media or competitors. Often in 突破/遭到围追堵截.
usage.zh: 本用于军事，现也指记者、对手。常说“突破/遭到围追堵截”。

meaning.en: To shake hands and end a quarrel or conflict.
meaning.zh: 握手谈和，结束争执或对立。

examples.zh: 两个老同学争吵多年，终于握手言和。
examples.en: The two old classmates, after years of quarrels, finally shook hands and made up.

examples.zh: 双方在调解下握手言和。
examples.en: Under mediation both sides shook hands and settled.

usage.en: Positive; used for individuals, groups or countries ending a dispute.
usage.zh: 褒义，可用于个人、团体、国家。

meaning.en: Hysterical; uncontrollably emotional or frantic, shouting wildly.
meaning.zh: 情绪异常激动，难以控制，举止失常（译自 hysteria）。

examples.zh: 她歇斯底里地大喊大叫，谁也劝不住。
examples.en: She screamed hysterically and no one could calm her.

examples.zh: 别这样歇斯底里，有话好好说。
examples.en: Don't be so hysterical; let's talk calmly.

usage.en: A loanword from 'hysteria', so the characters are for sound only. Negative; typically used as adverbial 歇斯底里地.
usage.zh: 外来词（hysteria的音译），汉字只表音。贬义，常作状语“歇斯底里地”。

meaning.en: To luckily survive or escape from a disaster.
meaning.zh: 侥幸地逃过灾难。

examples.zh: 地震中他因外出而幸免于难。
examples.en: He was away at the time and so escaped the earthquake.

examples.zh: 大火中，三名孩子幸免于难。
examples.en: Three children survived the fire.

usage.en: Only for those who escape; for those who die use 遇难. Pattern: 幸免于难 or 幸免于…
usage.zh: 指躲过灾难的人；遇难者不能用。

literal: life · fate · bound up with · concern
natural: a matter of life and death

meaning.en: A matter that affects life itself; life-and-death.
meaning.zh: 关系到生命安全，十分重要。

equivalents: a matter of life and death

examples.zh: 食品安全性命攸关，不能马虎。
examples.en: Food safety is a matter of life and death; no carelessness allowed.

examples.zh: 这是性命攸关的时刻，必须冷静。
examples.en: This is a life-or-death moment; we must stay calm.

usage.en: Formal; 攸 is a classical word meaning 'that which'; read yōu. Often modified by 事关/关乎.
usage.zh: 书面语。“攸”读 yōu，古语，意为“所”。

meaning.en: Having an open, honest and generous mind with nothing to hide.
meaning.zh: 心胸开阔，光明磊落，没有私心杂念。

examples.zh: 他胸怀坦荡，从不计较个人得失。
examples.en: He is open-hearted and never fusses about personal gain.

examples.zh: 面对质疑，她胸怀坦荡，主动公开账目。
examples.en: Facing doubts she was open and made the accounts public.

usage.en: Praise of a person's character. Compare the idiom 光明磊落.
usage.zh: 褒义，形容人品。与成语“光明磊落”相近。

meaning.en: Planned in advance over a long time (usually for something bad).
meaning.zh: 早就策划，积蓄谋划已久，多指坏事。

equivalents: carefully planned for a long time

examples.zh: 警方认定这是一起蓄谋已久的盗窃案。
examples.en: Police determined that this was a long-planned theft.

examples.zh: 他的离职并非一时冲动，而是蓄谋已久。
examples.en: His resignation was no whim; he had been plotting it for a long time.

usage.en: Mostly negative; common in crime reporting. 蓄 is xù (store up), not chù.
usage.zh: 多含贬义，常见于案件报道。“蓄”读 xù。

meaning.en: To provoke fights and make trouble deliberately; a legal term for hooliganism.
meaning.zh: 故意挑起事端，无事生非（法律用语）。

examples.zh: 他因寻衅滋事被警方拘留。
examples.en: He was detained by police for picking quarrels and causing disturbances.

examples.zh: 酒后寻衅滋事，是违法行为。
examples.en: Picking fights while drunk is against the law.

usage.en: Mainly a legal/news term (寻衅滋事罪). 衅 is xìn (quarrel); 滋 means 'stir up'.
usage.zh: 主要是法律、新闻用语（寻衅滋事罪）。

meaning.en: To outdo all other women (or flowers) in beauty.
meaning.zh: 容貌或姿色超过所有其他美女（花）。

equivalents: steal the show with one's beauty

examples.zh: 红毯上，她一袭红裙艳压群芳。
examples.en: On the red carpet, in a red dress, she outshone every other woman.

examples.zh: 牡丹艳压群芳，被誉为花中之王。
examples.en: The peony outshines all other flowers and is called the king of flowers.

usage.en: Praise of beauty only; for skill use 技压群雄. Used mostly for women and flowers.
usage.zh: 只形容美貌；形容技艺用“技压群雄”。

meaning.en: Swaying gracefully and charmingly (of plants, flames, or a dancer).
meaning.zh: 随风摆动，姿态优美动人。

examples.zh: 湖边的柳枝在微风中摇曳生姿。
examples.en: The willows by the lake swayed gracefully in the breeze.

examples.zh: 舞者裙摆摇曳生姿，引来阵阵掌声。
examples.en: The dancer's swirling skirt drew waves of applause.

usage.en: Literary; 曳 is yè, not yì. Subject: willows, flowers, candle flames, dancers, or even writing style.
usage.zh: 文学色彩。“曳”读 yè。多形容柳枝、花、烛火、舞者，也可形容文笔。

literal: one · not have · what · is strong

meaning.en: To have no special skill or strength at all.
meaning.zh: 没有任何专长或本领。

examples.zh: 他自认一无所长，不敢去应聘。
examples.en: He thought he had no skills at all and didn't dare apply.

examples.zh: 别妄自菲薄，没人是一无所长的。
examples.en: Don't belittle yourself; nobody is completely without a strength.

usage.en: Often self-deprecating or harsh judgement; 长 is read cháng (strength), not zhǎng.
usage.zh: 常用于自谦或严厉评价。“长”读 cháng，指专长。

meaning.en: Having enough food and clothing, with no worry about daily living.
meaning.zh: 穿的吃的都不用发愁，生活有保障。

examples.zh: 他退休后衣食无忧，每天养花钓鱼。
examples.en: After retirement he is comfortably off and spends his days gardening and fishing.

examples.zh: 父母只希望孩子一生衣食无忧。
examples.en: Parents just wish their children a life without material worry.

usage.en: Modest comfort rather than luxury; compare 丰衣足食 (well-clothed and fed).
usage.zh: 指基本生活有保障，不等于奢华。

natural: the regret of an overlooked pearl

meaning.en: The regret of failing to select a deserving talent or work.
meaning.zh: 指未能选中或发现有价值的人才、作品而感到遗憾。

equivalents: the regret of an overlooked gem

examples.zh: 这次评奖难免有遗珠之憾。
examples.en: In this award there are inevitably some deserving works left out.

examples.zh: 球队名单公布后，球迷们议论起遗珠之憾。
examples.en: After the squad was named, fans debated who was unfairly left out.

usage.en: Used for selections, awards, squad lists and talent searches. Compare 沧海遗珠 (a talent left in obscurity).
usage.zh: 多用于评奖、选拔、名单。

meaning.en: To die young, in one's prime.
meaning.zh: 在年轻有为的年纪过早去世。

equivalents: be cut off while still young

examples.zh: 这位才华横溢的作家英年早逝，令人惋惜。
examples.en: The brilliant writer died in his prime, which is a great pity.

examples.zh: 他英年早逝，留下了未完成的作品。
examples.en: He died young, leaving his work unfinished.

usage.en: For respected talented people; do not use for children or the elderly. A respectful, sorrowful expression.
usage.zh: 用于有才能、成就的人；不用于儿童或老人。

meaning.en: To keep growing and never decrease.
meaning.zh: 只有增加，没有减少。

examples.zh: 尽管治理多年，污染问题有增无减。
examples.en: Despite years of efforts the pollution problem has only grown.

examples.zh: 大家的热情有增无减。
examples.en: Everyone's enthusiasm has only grown.

usage.en: Neutral; can be positive (enthusiasm) or negative (problems), depending on what increases.
usage.zh: 中性，看增加的是什么，可褒可贬。
